name: EMC Home of Data - Rechenzentrum Rosenheim
notes: Official EMC page describes its Rosenheim data center for the Alpine region with direct connection to Campus MUC 1, PUE under 1.3, waste-heat use for the Kathrein campus, redundant power, Argon fire suppression and racks up to 9 kW. Verified in method round via operator official page.

name: roNet Aicherpark data center
notes: roNet operates an Internet POP in Rosenheim since 1996 with hosting/housing; backup page states storage in its Rosenheim data center; archive references guided tours through the Rechenzentrum im Aicherpark; Cloudscene lists roNet Aicherpark in Rosenheim.

name: KommunalBIT municipal IT data center (legacy, serving Erlangen/Fuerth/Schwabach)
notes: KommunalBIT AoeR is the municipal IT provider founded 2010 by Erlangen, Fuerth and Schwabach; a 2010 DataCenter-Insider article describes the centralized high-security Rechenzentrum of the three cities; headquarters is in Fuerth, so a Schwabach-local facility is not confirmed - status unknown.

name: Blue Swan AI Gigafactory / Conn Barracks data center
developer: Blue Swan consortium: Free State of Bavaria, Leibniz-Rechenzentrum/BAdW, Investa; Blue Swan Service GmbH planned as operator vehicle
notes: Bavarian government (cabinet report, Aiwanger workshop) describes Blue Swan as an AI Gigafactory concept in the EU competition using the Conn Barracks site (Schweinfurt district / Geldersheim); Soeder announced up to EUR 5bn investment; district/Geldersheim planning pages document the Bebauungsplan 'Gewerbepark Conn Barracks' process; 220 MW appears in public planning consultation material as project assumption while other official pages emphasize 100,000 GPUs.

name: ODAV AG Rechenzentrum
notes: ODAV official page advertises 'Unser Rechenzentrum' with company address Ernst-Heinkel-Strasse 11, 94315 Straubing. No capacity figure found.

name: Silicon Rosenheim AI Factory - Traunstein data-center zones
notes: Social-media posts describe one AI hub with four data-center zones including two in Landkreis Traunstein and EUR 50bn private investment; no permitting, site, utility interconnection or municipal filing found in targeted searches - unverified/vaporware until corroborated.

name: Polarise AI Data Center Amberg-Unterallgaeu
notes: Official Polarise/WV Energie announcements and trade press say an AI data center is planned in the municipality of Amberg (Landkreis Unterallgaeu, near Augsburg), 30 MW at launch mid-2027, scalable to 120 MW, on the former Wertachtal shortwave transmitter site.

name: Hetzner Ellingen data center and solar farm proposal
notes: Ellingen public information materials gave an end-state power requirement around 50 MW and DCD reported a 50 ha scheme (15 ha data center + 35 ha solar); 2026 NN reporting says Ellingen rejected Hetzner's siting while Treuchtlingen still seeks an operator.

name: Hetzner Gunzenhausen operations / headquarters site
notes: Hetzner is headquartered in Gunzenhausen; official history traces the company from local server capacity to datacenter parks elsewhere; 2026 local reporting notes construction of a new Gunzenhausen headquarters after an earlier local data-center effort failed. Regional operator/operations footprint, not a confirmed hyperscale build.

name: IDF / Landkreis Wunsiedel county data center
developer: Innovations- und Dienstleistungsgesellschaft Fichtelgebirge mbH (IDF) / Landkreis Wunsiedel
notes: County/IDF pages state IDF is establishing a data center for Landkreis Wunsiedel in Wunsiedel to meet local IT system needs; capacity and completion date not disclosed.

name: Smartes Fichtelgebirge school data-center cluster
notes: Official Smartes Fichtelgebirge article described planned high-performance server/data-center installations at school centers in Marktredwitz and Selb and around the Landratsamt for local school IT independence; approx. EUR 1M cost, capacity not reported.

name: SWW Wunsiedel Schneebergturm data center concept
notes: Regional reporting says SWW Wunsiedel planned a data center at the Schneeberg tower site; older Kurier reporting quoted SWW leadership that the Schneeberg buildings were well suited for a data center. No capacity or construction confirmation found.

name: Rockenstein Wuerzburg / Veitshoechheim data centers
notes: Rockenstein (Wuerzburg ISP) operates TUEViT-certified data centers; GDA partner page confirms company in Wuerzburg/Veitshoechheim; 2019 local reporting describes a planned four-storey office building with data center on 1.4 ha in Veitshoechheim (Landkreis Wuerzburg). Capacity not disclosed.

name: DC:MAIN Datacenter Mainfranken
notes: Official DC:MAIN site identifies the regional Wuerzburg data center/operator (Lengfeld area); DCHub reports Datacenter Mainfranken in Wuerzburg as operational with 3.0 MW power capacity. Capacity from third-party database.

name: euNetworks Colocation Wuerzburg
notes: PeeringDB and data-center directories list an active euNetworks colocation facility at Hertzstrasse 2, 97076 Wuerzburg; Datacenters.com reports 4,306 sq ft raised floor and ISO 27001, but no power capacity.
